claims.claim: Black Hills has announced 564 megawatts of new natural-gas generation at Cheyenne Prairie Generating Station in Cheyenne, Wyoming, to be built between 2027 and 2029 for Google's planned data centre.

claims.claim: BigGo Finance reports Samsung's HBM market share at 33 percent based on a Damnang Research interview published October 6.

claims.supporting_quote: In the competitive landscape for high-bandwidth memory (HBM), Samsung Electronics is pressuring long-time leader SK Hynix from two directions simultaneously: rapid market share gains and an early advantage in validating next-generation advanced packaging technology.

claims.supporting_quote: As early as June 18, SK Hynix announced it had delivered 12-layer HBM4E samples to major customers, with 48GB capacity, using its existing Advanced MR-MUF packaging technology. The company said the product achieves a 17% improvement in thermal resistance compared to HBM4.
